entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet a while ago, and I'm just so confused by the website. I have the box unopened right here.
I can certainly help you look into that. Just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the helmet, or is this more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, nothing is broken. It's just... the color. It's not what I thought it would be. I feel so silly. I just don't understand the returns page. Can't you just help me?
Of course. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order. I see you purchased the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered about 42 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that too long? I'm sorry, I'm just overwhelmed with this.

Not at all. Let me check the policy for you. Okay, I see here that for a standard item like this helmet, you have 90 days to make a return. Since you're within that window, I can go ahead and approve this for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy and, most importantly, have the right gear for your safety. I'm glad the box is unopened, that makes the process much simpler. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now. Do you have a printer available?
Yes, I do! Thank you, David. You've been a great help.

It's my pleasure. You should receive that email within the next five minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
